detail.longDescription: Complete breakdown of every way to save Firefox tabs for later: - Bookmark All Tabs: permanent archive, no one-click restore - Firefox Sync: cross-device, requires Mozilla account - Tab Groups (131+): in-session visual grouping only, doesn't save - Session manager extensions: named workspaces, save+close+restore with one click, local only https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/how-to -save-firefox-tabs-for-later-all-methods-from-built-in-to-extensions-59ab # Firefox # Productivity # TabManagement # BrowserTips
